members.name: Auto Merge
members.description: Automatically merge open PRs that have passing CI, no blocking reviews, and no conflicts

members.name: Auto-Workflow Builder
members.description: Analyze a URL and generate a tailored aeon.yml schedule with skill suggestions

members.name: Autoresearch
members.description: Evolve a skill by generating variations, evaluating them, and updating the best version

members.name: Autoresearch Goal
members.description: Evolve the system in service of a stated goal — discovers relevant files across skills/prototypes/workflows, generates cross-file improvement proposals, scores by goal impact, ships the winner as a PR

members.name: batch-health
members.description: Daily post-batch audit — checks whether all enabled scheduled skills fired in their expected morning window, alerts on silent misses, files issues on batch-level outages

members.name: Config Validator
members.description: Validate aeon.yml and .github/workflows/aeon.yml for structural invariants that have caused past outages — checkout step ordering, duplicate skill keys, missing skill files

members.name: Create Skill
members.description: Generate a complete new skill from a one-line prompt and ship it as a PR

members.name: GitLawb Fleet
members.description: Spawn, renew, and kill GitLawb-hosted Aeon instances via short-lived UCAN capabilities — the off-switch layer GitLawb v0.1 lacks

members.name: GitLawb Fleet Metrics
members.description: Daily observability snapshot for the GitLawb-hosted fleet — instances, renewal pass-rate, blocklist events, merge-gate activity — to notify + dashboard

members.name: memory-structural-dedupe
members.description: Detect and collapse structural duplicate rows in MEMORY.md — sections like Recent Articles and Skills Built that accumulate multiple content blocks across memory-flush cycles. Companion to scripts/memory-dedupe (topic-pointer dedup); this handles section-level row accumulation.

members.name: Repo Scanner
members.description: Catalog GitHub repos into a prioritized fleet report with concrete, coded opportunities that downstream skills consume directly

members.name: skill-enabler
members.description: Flip enabled:false → enabled:true for a comma-separated list of skill slugs in aeon.yml — validate against skills/, fail loudly on already-enabled or missing slugs, commit, open a PR with per-skill rationale

members.name: skill-freshness
members.description: Audit every enabled skill's upstream file dependencies for staleness — flags chained skills about to consume yesterday's article or a long-dead topic file

members.name: Skill Dependency Graph
members.description: Generate a navigable Mermaid dependency map of all skills with change detection, per-category drill-downs, and enabled overlay

members.name: Skill Repair
members.description: Diagnose and fix failing or degraded skills automatically — systemic-first triage, per-category playbooks, verification plan

members.name: Stale Content PR Sweeper
members.description: Close auto-generated content PRs (notegraph/, suggest-edges/, etc.) once a newer run of the same skill has opened its successor — keeps the queue clear and stops conflict-rebase work that would only reach broken intermediate states

members.name: SWARM Safety Eval
members.description: Grade the fleet's own multi-agent safety dynamics with SWARM soft-metrics (toxicity, quality gap, welfare), diff vs the prior eval, and notify on regression

members.name: Vercel Projects
members.description: Triage Vercel deploy fleet — verdict, errored-first, what-changed since last snapshot
